title: PSA: Google AI Pro is 50% off for Black Friday for existing Google subscribers.
author: Recoil42
selftext:
Saw this mentioned in a couple other threads, but felt it deserved its own thread because the deal is quite good: 

[https://x.com/vikaskansalHQ/status/2123833450297995624](https://x.com/vikaskansalHQ/status/2123833450297995624)

You can sign up monthly and it'll only be eligible for a few, but if you sign up annually, you get the whole year 50% off. Less than $10/mo gets you: 

* Google Antigravity w/ Neon Access and a Pro quota
* 5 TB of Google Drive cloud storage
* US$10 in monthly Google Cloud credits
* 200 compute units per month in Google Colab
* YouTube Premium Lite
* Google Health Premium
* Google Home Premium

In practice the quota seems to be *roughly* equivalent to a Claude $20 quota with Neon being somewhere between Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2. Switch to Hydrogen to stretch your quota out. It won't be enough for professionals, but is about perfect for hobbyists. 

You must be an existing paid subscriber, as far as I know. There are apparently other deals floating around for new subscribers, but I'm not sure what they are.

comments.author: YouKnowItsMeStudios
comments.body:
Gemini Neon is just so freaking good.

We originally had the Pro version for our nest cams so we could have video storage.

Decided to try out Neon, it convinced me to upgrade to the $100 ultra.

I will say, even on Pro on medium and high effort, the usage is fair.

On the $100 Ultra it feels like an absolute steal.

FYI, if the prorated fee works like most places, you can prolly get a small discount on Ultra to if you buy the half off pro then upgrade to Ultra.

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body: I'm very impressed with Neon as well. I've never seen a model this eager to take on hard tasks. It blazes through massive optimization tasks and deep research.

replies.author: Recoil42
replies.body:
>I want it because Neon is so good (in one day, it literally just doubled the FPS on a game that Astra/Fable just spent 3 weeks optimizing already!)

Similar results. Astra and Opus have been trying to optimize my level load times for a week or so with solid incremental returns. Took at crack at it with Neon today and it casually delivered a lossless 5x return by re-architecting the entire shader compilation pipeline one-shot. No sweat.

Very impressive model. Antigravity has had a huge turnaround too.

I just mentioned this in another comment however..

I think I finally figured it out. Those of us with subscriptions or whatever it is that I was looking at.. I went through my email and I found something in small text "Offer ends Nov 26, 2026." Even though there's literally huge black Friday pictures and text all over the place. This was an early bird, pre Black Friday sale.

"The early-access Black Friday promotion for existing Google One and AI subscribers officially ended on Thursday, November 26, 2026, which is why the discount vanished from your account at midnight."

So I guess my money will be going to another company then. I'm not super worried about the storage I actually kind of wanted it for the AI. Well there are others to choose from.
